open-asr-2026-10-17.title: Open ASR English short-form results, October 17, 2026
open-asr-2026-10-17.quote: AMI-Cleaned WER,Earnings22-Cleaned-AA-chunked WER,Gigaspeech-Cleaned WER,LS Clean WER,LS Other WER,SPGISpeech WER
open-asr-2026-10-17.note: Maintainer publication. The CSV does not attribute execution for each row; publication is not proof of independent reproduction. Per-dataset WER columns are imported verbatim. Its avg and RTFx aggregate columns are deliberately not imported; the dashboard default dataset mix has changed.

open-asr-protocol.title: Open ASR dataset and metric documentation
open-asr-protocol.note: Documents cleaned reference variants, session-level Earnings22 scoring and the distinction between URGENT24 clean and noisy versions. Actual dataset revisions and individual run operators are not pinned by the CSV.

open-asr-phonon-protocol.title: Open ASR Phonon-2 evaluation configuration
open-asr-phonon-protocol.note: Configuration names librispeech test.clean/test.other; ami_cleaned, gigaspeech_cleaned, voxpopuli_cleaned_aa, spgispeech and URGENT test splits; Earnings22 uses ArtificialAnalysis/Earnings22-Cleaned-AA-chunked. Documents H200, batch 64, bfloat16 and full sets. This is documentation, not proof that a particular CSV row used that exact script revision.

open-asr-phonon-engine.title: Open ASR Phonon-2 reference evaluation engine
open-asr-phonon-engine.note: Expands Phonon weights to a dense Transformers graph. Its CUDA throughput is not the packed Apple runtime throughput. Do not equate leaderboard H200 batch speed with Mac single-stream measurements.

fermion-phonon-2-launch.title: Fermion Research: Introducing Phonon-2, Tables 1–3
fermion-phonon-2-launch.quote: the other rows were scored with its code on the full test sets
fermion-phonon-2-launch.note: Unmarked Phonon-2 and Phonon-1 accuracy rows are author runs; Redux is a competitor run by Fermion. Daggered accuracy rows are copied from an unspecified leaderboard revision, not new Fermion runs. Short dataset labels do not pin cleaned-reference versions or dataset commits. Keep this table separate from the current maintainer protocol. Table 3 is a 20-dictation throughput workload, not a standardized accuracy family.

deepgram-pricing.title: Deepgram official speech API pricing
deepgram-pricing.note: Pay-as-you-go standard rates are separate from Growth discounts and current streaming promotions; optional diarization/keyterm add-ons are excluded. Minute rates are normalized only by multiplying by 60.

assembly-pricing.title: AssemblyAI official API pricing
assembly-pricing.note: Pre-recorded Pay As You Go Universal-3.5 Pro is $0.21 per audio hour; Universal-2 is $0.15. Optional add-ons and realtime products are separate.

gladia-pricing.title: Gladia official speech API pricing
gladia-pricing.note: Self-serve async Solaria-3, 0–100 hours/month, is EUR 0.16 per hour. Live service is EUR 0.68 per hour. Currency stays EUR; no USD exchange-rate assumption.

mistral-transcribe-pricing.title: Mistral Voxtral Mini Transcribe 2602 official model pricing
mistral-transcribe-pricing.note: USD 0.003 per minute for hosted Voxtral Mini Transcribe 2602. This is not the open Voxtral Mini 4B Realtime 2602 checkpoint.

soniox-pricing.title: Soniox official token pricing
soniox-pricing.quote: All API costs are calculated based on tokens.
soniox-pricing.note: The page gives approximate hourly equivalents, not flat hourly tariffs. Actual per-million audio/text token rates are preserved; no hourly price is inferred.

open-asr-multilingual-protocol.title: Open ASR multilingual prepared test datasets
open-asr-multilingual-protocol.note: Prepared FLEURS, MCV and MLS test configurations use corpus_language names. Exact dataset commit for each published run is unspecified. Armenian is hosted separately; Hindi uses public Monsoon lattice references and voi-oiwer, as documented in Open ASR constants.
